headline: A film about Palestinian struggles galvanizes a Carmel Valley woman to take action.
summary: Julie Drezner’s family dates back generations to Bethlehem, and was part of the estimated 700,000 to 750,000 Palestinians forced to leave their homes after the Nakba–Arabic for “catastrophe” – as the State of Israel was created in 1948.
source: Monterey County Weekly / Monterey County NOW
